transcript: Mareez mard, 28 saal. Paanch din se tez bukhar hai, sar dard aur kamzori bhi hai. Kehnda ae raat nu bohat thand lagdi ae. Ulti nahi hai, dast bhi nahi. Typhoid ka test positive aaya hai. Azomax 500 rozana ek goli, saat din. Panadol do goli din mein teen baar, jab bukhar ho. Teen din baad dobara aayein.

medications.name: Azomax
medications.dose: one tablet daily for seven days
medications.instructions: Azomax 500 rozana ek goli, saat din

medications.name: Panadol
medications.dose: two tablets three times a day when fever is present
medications.frequency: three times a day when fever is present
medications.instructions: Panadol do goli din mein teen baar, jab bukhar ho. Teen din baad dobara aayein
